name: zinterp_context_dispatch_core_command
description: zInterp_Context::DispatchCoreCommand handles the recovered hard-coded engine command table.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.

Binary Ninja renders the original VC5 dispatcher as a large switch/if-chain with several inline string-compare flag-lift warnings, so final tier S work should verify the whole dispatcher/source cluster rather than individual branches.
The functional target exercises representative behavior for every implemented command family, but final tier S acceptance should verify the whole zInterp parser/runtime source cluster.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja evidence for 0x4c20a0 was used to recover the dispatcher command families and exact-vs-prefix match behavior.
python tools/recoil.py audit zinterp is an optional watcher-facing export audit for comparing the source command table against local Binary Ninja text dumps when present.
